# Bug template

## 🐛 Bug
Destination field becomes locked after selecting a room in indoor navigation.

## 📍 Location
Indoor navigation – destination selection.

## ❌ Current Behavior
User cannot change the destination unless they restart the navigation process.

## ✅ Expected Behavior
User should be able to change the destination freely after selecting a room.

## 📝 Notes
Might require enabling map tap listeners for both start and destination fields.
